ICS 25.080.01PGD 35New Standard from Last Update.NATIONAL FOREWORDThis Indian Standard (Part 3) which is identical with ISO 16092-3 : 2017 ‘Machine tools safety - Presses - Part 3: Safety requirements for hydraulic presses’ issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on recommendation of the Machine Tools, Machine Tool Elements and Holding Devices Sectional Committee, and approval of the Production and General Engineering Division Council.
